title: Passion Is Dangerous
coreMove: Stop using immediate emotional fit as a verdict when early work may still be too immature to judge.
sourcePressure: Passion-first thinking can create stress, burnout, over-monitoring, and premature identity pressure.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning this into advice to stay in every bad job or ignore exploitation.

sourceAnchors.name: A broad interest becomes heavier
sourceAnchors.detail: The frozen source supports passion mindset stress and burnout by turning broad interests into obligations.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A broad interest becomes heavier when it is asked to prove a whole identity before it has matured.

sourceAnchors.name: College becomes less frantic
sourceAnchors.detail: The source supports developing passions over time rather than obeying assumed preexisting ones.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: College becomes less frantic when treated as a workshop, not a court where your calling is on trial.
